scope: Development-only reuse of the canonical full guide within one Edit operation; slow-publication characterization is an unresolved limitation.

behavior.reuse: Only the exact full SDK result just fetched/verified by this Edit action. Not a persistent cache or partial reading view.
guards: Exact workflow ID, revision and original canonical SHA compared against draft link
Real editing lease acquired, its baseRevision compared with full-guide revision
Newer lease revision rejects Edit, releases acquired lease and preserves complete draft
Reopening an existing draft without a fresh result still obtains a fresh complete guide

slowEdit.method: Actual CDP 64KiB/s upload/download and120ms latency; no response rewriting
slowEdit.previous: ~23 seconds and two full Edit transfers; source-fingerprinted earlier evidence in team-progressive-read-2026-10-19.json

slowPublication.next: Evaluate bounded time budgets for large guide upload/response, accounting for server body deadlines and lease expiry. Preserve manual retry, exact keys, strict body/hash/fencing and cancellation.
